findings.detail: Strict App capture validation recognizes the exact final profiler helper identity and cprofile summary field without widening old helper arms.
Captured, unavailable, and no-eligible-profile states are validated against the helper's actual emission behavior.

Mutation controls reject private paths/payloads/keys/URLs/locals, unknown fields, duplicate identities, bounds violations, negative or non-finite arithmetic, invalid edge counts, ranking changes, and missing overhead semantics.
Mounted browser/bootstrap body and live D66 activation were not run; the source-only validator arm is not production-path qualification.
